title: Endoscopic submucosal dissection for treatment of advanced colorectal neoplasia
summary: Retrospective analysis of a prospective registry to evaluate clinical efficacy and complications of colorectal endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) for the treatment of colorectal neoplasia (adenoma / early invasive cancer).
conditions: Benign neoplasm: Anus and anal canal

interventions.name: Patients to be included will have flat or sessile colorectal neoplasia > 20mm amenable to endoscopic treatment. Endoscopic resection will be done with endoscopic submucosal dissection rather than by piecemeal mucosectomy.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Age> 18 years, sessile or flat adenomatous neoplasia > 20mm, signed informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
coagulopathy  (INR > 1.5, Thrombocyts < 100G/l)
VKA antagonists, DOAK, dual antiplatelet therapy that cannot be interrupted
severe comorbidity, life exspectancy < 6 months
ASA status > III 
pregnancy and breastfeeding
severe fibrosis or submucosal invasion of adenoma / cancer 
poor access to the lesion
